question: List the long name of teams with above-average build-up play passing in 2012.
final_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name FROM Team_Attributes AS TA JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012' AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > ( SELECT 1.0 * SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) / COUNT(T2.team_long_name) FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2 JOIN Team AS T2 ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012' AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY T.team_long_name;
